disclosure: Repeated development matches, shared home team. WMX and WN1 already consumed by R7; excluded from selection.
partial_transfer: SkillCorner 1874553 previously examined; first heldout fold WPY fixed, not model ranking; no complete D truth
hypothesis: Independent player motion can support Alive when ball is missing but players remain observable; cannot identify state from zero detected players.
features: player_only_v1: 46 original-player aggregates, m/s and m/s2, centered .5/2/5s activity windows; no ball/status/labels; same-tracklet differences only; no window across missing frames/period/all-player missing
training: 3 leave-one-match-out Alive HGB fits, natural full source labels; 2Hz deterministic subsample; 25Hz full-period scores; no sample weighting
home_head: frozen R6-M2; separate attribution, not refit for P1
decoder: frozen M2 costs team=3*fps/10, dead=1*fps/10, no M3 tuning
gate_A: Use player Alive only after .5 seconds continuously missing ball AND at least 8 detected/available players per team AND speed observed fraction >= .5; otherwise frozen M2. Period/frame-gap reset. No labels.
calibration_B: Separate later experiment: one match fit, one match calibrate, third evaluate, rotating fixed listed order; MUST refit both experts on sole fit match, not calibrate existing two-match LOMO heads on their training data. Compare same-training uncalibrated control. No deployment promotion from 3 matches.
guardrail: Gate A eligible for KEEP_RESEARCH only if dropout and long mean spellF1 gains >= .01, >=2/3 match gains, natural delta >= -.01 each, true D missed frame rate increases <= .02 each domain/match, and SkillCorner longmissing falseD <1. Otherwise EXPERIMENTAL/REVERT. Player-only remains diagnostic even if complete score poor.
no_observation: Do not interpret missing player probability as evidence; evaluate it diagnostically and disclose support. Any temporal fallback requires a separately frozen rule and true-D guardrail.
counterfactual: Separate preregistration after first real results: label-independent raw ball freeze/replay/noise; rebuild all44. Ablation alone cannot identify shortcut contribution.
evaluation: Unchanged official scorer; full spell5IoU, macroF1, D/HA confusion, rawargmax/decoded, falseDcuts/trueDmisses, typed boundaries, Brier/logloss/ECE descriptively (uncalibrated), per-match/episode counts, no frame-IID interval
preservation: Exclusive new model/run paths; completed stages reused by verified hash, no previous artifact overwrite
